offering_description.value: Markets and sells over-the-counter healthcare and personal care brands to retailers, which sell them to consumers. Manufacturing is outsourced to third-party contract manufacturers.

primary_products.value: eye and ear care; pain relievers; cough and cold remedies; digestive remedies; feminine care

customer_segment.value: B2B: large retail chains, drugstores, mass merchandisers, grocery and club stores, wholesalers; B2C: consumers buying over-the-counter remedies for eye, pain, digestive and women's health needs

end_markets.value: consumer healthcare; over-the-counter drugs; personal care; retail

revenue_model.value: product sales: branded over-the-counter healthcare and personal care products sold to retailers and wholesalers

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: takes in finished products from contract manufacturers and sells them under its brands to retailers

geography_served.value: global: US is the largest market, also Canada, Australia and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: eye and ear care, pain relief, cough and cold, digestive, oral care, women's health and first aid brands sold through the same retail channels

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling to national retail chains and drugstore accounts; third-party retail: mass merchandisers, drugstores, grocery and club stores that sell to consumers; distributors / dealers: wholesale distributors serving smaller independent pharmacies and outlets; online: retailer websites and online marketplaces selling its brands to consumers
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; third-party retail; distributors / dealers; online

regulatory_exposure.value: high: OTC drug products under FDA monograph rules and cGMP manufacturing requirements, plus product labeling and safety reporting rules
